interface.signature: def printPaths(root: TreeNode, S: int) -> list[list[int]]

preconditions.expression: isinstance(root, TreeNode) or root is None
preconditions.description: root is either a TreeNode instance or None, representing an empty tree.
S is an integer between 1 and 1,000,000 (inclusive).

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(node.val, int) and 1 <= node.val <= 10**6 for node in [root] if node is not None)
preconditions.description: Every node's value in the tree is an integer between 1 and 1,000,000 (inclusive).

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(path, list) and all(isinstance(val, int) for val in path) for path in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each path in the returned list is a list of integers representing node values.
Each path contains at least one node (root).

postconditions.expression: all(sum(path) == S for path in return_value)
postconditions.description: The sum of node values in each path equals the input sum S.

postconditions.expression: all(path[0] == root.val if root else True for path in return_value)
postconditions.description: Every path starts with the root node's value (if root exists).

postconditions.expression: not any(path[-1] == leaf.val and leaf.left is None and leaf.right is None for path in return_value for leaf in [root] if root is not None)
postconditions.description: No path ends on a leaf node (a node with no children).

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) == len({tuple(path) for path in return_value})
postconditions.description: All paths in the result are unique (no duplicate paths).
